<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-1816-32-43">'di'i lan la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs>
               <lb n="34a4"/>na de rang gi yul la ltos nas rtog pa'i rdzas dang bral 1 yin zer | 'di mi rigs te de ltar na rtag pa la rtog pa myong ba'i rang rig ldog 'di rtog bra ma yin par 'gyur | rang gi shugs yul rtag pa'i don spyi las ltos te rtog pa'i rdzas dang ma bral ba'i phyir | des na 'di'i lan ni khyed ltar na byas pa sgra mi rtag sgrub kyi gtan tshigs yin ces pa den
               <lb n="34a5"/>rtags kyi rdzas yin pas sam ldog pa yin pas bya | dang po ltar na sgra rang yang de'i gtan tshigs su 'gyur 2 pa ltar na byas ldog kyang gtan tshigs ma yin par thal byas pa la | nyes pa med de tshul 3 gyis rtags kyi tha snyad du mtshon pa'i mtshan gzhi yin pas na gtan tshigs yin zhe na | 'dir yang drang ldog la rtog pa'i mtshid mi rten spga
               <lb n="34a6"/>na rtog br pa yin |</seg></TEI>
